subject: Southport Hosted API rate exception (30% request)
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <j.miles@southport.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Southport — Hosted API proposal and ask

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We're working through procurement and would like to get a two-year committed pricing proposal for your Hosted API for embeddings + generation.

Top-level ask: Southport is requesting a 35% off list rate for committed usage given competitive pressure and a multiyear rollout. Our initial estimate is ~1B tokens / month year 1 (burst to 1.6B) with predictable growth.

Can you share a firmed SOW and committed-use price with any conditions? Legal will need standard data residency and SOC2 statements (we can share a questionnaire if needed).

Attached: Southport_RFP_2026.pdf (RFP + forecast).

Regards,
Jordan Miles
Head of Product Partnerships
Southport Inc.
attachments: Southport_RFP_2026.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Southport — Hosted API proposal and ask (need exec clearance for >20% concession)

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Southport's ask. Summary below with quick math and recommended route. Need exec clearance for an exception above our standard concession cap (20%).

Summary: Southport requests 35% off list for a 24-month committed Hosted API deal. Forecast: ~1B tokens/month start -> expected average 1.2B tokens/mo over year 1. Current list = $0.0006 / token (example for combined generation+embeddings blended).

At list: ~ $720k/month -> ~$8.6M / year.
At 30% off: ~$504k/month -> ~$6.05M / year.
At 35% off: ~$468k/month -> ~$5.6M / year.

Why 30% might make sense: large enterprise footprint, high expansion potential across several product lines, short sales cycle if we lock 24 months and include revenue-protection clauses.
Risks: margin goes below floor if they push to 40%+ or if usage skews heavily to peak bursts without commensurate commit.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-model.xlsx (breakdown), SOW_Southport_v3.pdf (initial SOW draft).

Ask: Rishi / Lauren — can we approve a one-time exception up to 30% (not to exceed) contingent on: 1) 24-month committed term, 2) minimum annual committed spend $2.5M, 3) 90-day prepay or irrevocable PO, 4) revenue protection clause (auto-rollback to list at renewal if no renewal), and 5) legal sign-off on data residency. If yes, I'll present this to Jordan and circulate a DocuSign SOW.

Thanks — need a reply by EOD to keep momentum.

— Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-pricing-model.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), SOW_Southport_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

Logan — quick notes from deal desk:

- Verify forecast cadence: is the 1B tokens/mo committed or an initial estimate? We need committed floor to size the commit.
- Recommend anchor: minimum committed ARR $2.5M for 24 months (we can model 30% to hit a $3.5M total contract value over two years).
- Require revenue-protection: step-down/auto-rollback language at renewal and a minimum transaction price floor.
- Legal: ask Jordan for SOC2 report and any special data residency contract language now; include an exhibit in the SOW.

If you can confirm the committed floor and prepay/PO cadence, I support pitching 30% as a one-time exec exception. We should also flag: discount matrix must only apply to hosted API; Dedicated/private pricing excluded.

I'll prep deal desk one-pager with margin impact and suggested approval language — will circulate before EOD.

Marissa
Senior Manager, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Southport — Hosted API proposal and ask (need exec clearance for >20% concession)

Thanks team — read quickly and agree to a controlled exception. Conditions for approval (my sign-off):

1) Up to 30% max (do not exceed).
2) 24-month committed term with minimum committed ARR $2.5M (total contract value >= $2.5M).
3) 90 days prepay or an irrevocable PO with payment milestones.
4) Revenue protection clause: prices automatically revert to list at renewal unless an approved renewal discount is granted.
5) Include an anti-cannibalization clause to prevent mixing Dedicated pricing.
6) Legal to approve data-residency exhibit and SOC2 evidence.

Please prepare a one-page memo for Lauren (CFO) summarizing margin impact and the ask — she'll give final clearance on financial exposure. Marissa, please include suggested contract language for rollback + measurement of committed usage.

Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Southport — conditional offer and SOW link

Jordan — great to move quickly. Per our internal discussion, we can extend a one-time, conditional rate exception up to 30% off list for Hosted API subject to the following:

1) 24-month committed term.
2) Minimum committed ARR (pre-discount) of $2.5M across the term.
3) 90 days prepay or an irrevocable PO.
4) Revenue protection: prices revert to standard list at renewal unless a new discount is approved.
5) Legal/data residency exhibit and SOC2 review included as SOW exhibits.

If you confirm those terms, we'll issue the SOW (attached) and a DocuSign envelope for signature. We are targeting closure and first invoice by Dec 15 to align with your rollout.

SOW (draft): SOW_Southport_v3.pdf
Pricing model (illustrative): redwood-pricing-model.xlsx
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/southport/signer/ABC123

Can you confirm: committed monthly token floor, acceptance of the 24-month commit and prepay, and legal contact for SOC2/residency review?

Thanks — excited to partner.

— Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW_Southport_v3.pdf, redwood-pricing-model.xlsx
